name: Rudra Ecovation Limited
about: Rudra Ecovation Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of cotton polyester yarns and knitted clothes in India. It offers rPet polyester flakes, rPet polyester staple fibre, and yarns. The company also provides home furnishing products and acoustic panel solutions. In addition, it manufactures clothing products using recycled PET fabric made of plastic bottles. The company sells product through its brand Anaura. Rudra Ecovation Limited was formerly known as Himachal Fibres Limited and changed its name to Rudra Ecovation Limited in March 2024. Rudra Ecovation Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Ludhiana, India.
